title: Electric Service Agreement Chronic-Outage Credit Amount Where Outage Counts Exceed the Threshold, in Worked Figures
content:
**Rule (Electric Service Agreement).** The chronic credit amount is three times (3 times) the schedule's chronic outage credit amount when the outage records in the chronic look-back reach the chronic threshold plus four or more, twice (2 times) that amount when they reach the threshold plus two or three, and otherwise no increase applies.

**Records read.** The outage records at the service address that began within the chronic look-back. Every outage record at the address counts, whatever its duration, cause or major event day.

**Bands.**

| Outage records in the chronic look-back | Chronic credit amount |
|---|---|
| the chronic threshold plus 4, or more | 3 times the schedule's chronic outage credit amount |
| the chronic threshold plus 2 or plus 3 | 2 times the schedule's chronic outage credit amount |
| the chronic threshold, or the threshold plus 1 | no increase applies |

**Where the amount acts.** The chronic credit amount so set is the figure the chronic-outage credit is built from; it is not rounded on its own.

**Worked example 1 (hypothetical).** Chronic threshold 5, schedule chronic outage credit amount $30.00.

| Records in the look-back | Above the threshold by | Chronic credit amount |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0 | $30.00 |
| 6 | 1 | $30.00 |
| 7 | 2 | $60.00 |
| 8 | 3 | $60.00 |
| 9 | 4 | $90.00 |
| 12 | 7 | $90.00 |

**Worked example 2 (hypothetical).** Chronic threshold 4, schedule chronic outage credit amount $22.50, 7 records in the look-back: 7 is the threshold plus 3, so the chronic credit amount is $45.00.
